title: The Lost Metal
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The fourth and last Wax and Wayne Mistborn novel, closing out the second era of the series. A shadowy enemy and a deepening crisis in the city set the lawman, his partner and their friends against a threat with global consequences.
readIf: you've been following the Wax and Wayne books and want a high-stakes finale with the humour intact.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier Mistborn books, since the finale depends on them.

pairings.reason: The series' starting point, if you want the original world and its plot to give this finale more weight.
Same author's larger epic, for a longer and more intricate shared-universe adventure.
A shorter, atmospheric fantasy with a distinct magic system and a heroine who faces something old.
